name: two-phase-domain-direct-capacitive-to-capacitive-connection-is-rejected
source:
LiquidVolume V1(C=1e-7, P0=200000)
LiquidVolume V2(C=1e-7, P0=200000)
connect(V1.out, V2.in)

error.message: connect(...): capacitive volumes [v1, v2] are connected directly with no resistance between them (C-C). Two pressure-storage volumes at one node make the DAE index-2; interpose a resistive flow element between them (the C-R-C rule).
